description: Scheduled tasks managed by Cowork's native Scheduled Tasks panel. These tasks run independent of any active session. Set each task up in Cowork via /schedule — use the cowork_prompt field as the task prompt. Mark configured: true after setup.
setup: Run /rigby scheduled-setup for copy-paste setup cards.

tasks.name: Morning Briefing
tasks.description: Weekday morning briefing — prose narrative synthesis of the day's calendar, priorities, overdue delegations, and rock alignment. Delivered at 6:30am before the day starts.
tasks.cowork_prompt: Run the chief-morning skill to deliver the morning briefing.

tasks.name: Auto Daily Review
tasks.description: Autonomous nightly review — synthesizes yesterday's task completions, calendar, and system state into a first-person narrative journal entry written to the knowledge system only. Runs at 4am without user input.
tasks.cowork_prompt: Run the chief-review skill with arguments: auto. No user interaction needed.
tasks.setup_note: Requires Keep Awake to be enabled in Cowork — this task fires at 4am while you're asleep.

tasks.name: Weekly Review Prep
tasks.description: Sunday morning weekly review prep — rocks, task management health, delegations, relationship warmth, system error analysis, commitment gap detection across all sources, and pattern analysis. Delivered at 8am before the week begins.
tasks.cowork_prompt: Run the quinn-weekly-review skill to prepare the weekly review document.

tasks.name: Rock 1 — Revenue Monthly Pull
tasks.description: Monthly revenue pull from Enterprise Scorecard v4. Filters to Dallas and South Texas separately, collects Revenue vs. Target, Revenue vs. Prior Year, Sequential Quarterly, and Monthly Revenue. Appends dated snapshot to Mind/One Texas/Rock 1 - Revenue Snapshots.md in Obsidian. Recency gate prevents double-writes. Run timing assumes data is locked by the 10th — push manually to 12th/13th if 10th falls on a weekend.
tasks.cowork_prompt: Run the Rock 1 monthly revenue workflow: read and follow workflows/rock1-revenue-monthly/workflow.md in full. Pull Dallas and South Texas revenue data from Enterprise Scorecard v4, check Obsidian for existing month entry, append if not present. No user interaction needed.

tasks.name: Rock 4 — Pipeline Weekly Pull
tasks.description: Weekly co-sell and pipeline pull from Sales Analytics. Runs co-sell-pipeline skill (partner breakdown + Rock 4 gap to $15M target) and pipeline-snapshot skill (90-day weighted pipeline + total pipeline for Dallas and South Texas). Appends dated weekly snapshot to Mind/One Texas/Rock 4 - Pipeline Snapshots.md in Obsidian. Weekly cadence reflects fluid pipeline data.
tasks.cowork_prompt: Run the Rock 4 weekly pipeline workflow: read and follow workflows/rock4-pipeline-weekly/workflow.md in full. Pull co-sell pipeline and 90-day weighted pipeline for One Texas, append dated weekly snapshot to Obsidian. No user interaction needed.

tasks.name: Wine Monitor — Hour of Power
tasks.description: Last Bottle Wine Monitor — starts daemon at the Hour of Power (highest priority window for cult Napa Cab, collectibles, library vintages). Polls every 2-3 minutes through remaining drop windows and alerts via Slack DM when a match is found.
tasks.cowork_prompt: Run: python3 /home/user/Jarvis/systems/wine-monitor/monitor.py --daemon. This starts the Last Bottle wine monitor in daemon mode. It will poll lastbottlewines.com every 2-10 minutes depending on the active drop window and send Slack DM alerts when wines matching David's taste profile appear. Let it run — it auto-adjusts polling frequency and stops at midnight.
tasks.setup_note: Daemon runs from 1 PM through midnight. For earlier coverage (11 AM Pinot Hour), add a second scheduled task at 10:55 AM or install system cron via: bash /home/user/Jarvis/systems/wine-monitor/install.sh

tasks.name: Content Pipeline — Discovery
tasks.description: Daily content discovery — reads URLs dropped in #content Slack (last 24 hours), drafts a blog post in David's voice, uploads a landscape Unsplash image, creates a Ghost draft with locked tags, and posts a review notification to #content. David replies in the thread to approve, reject, or give feedback.
tasks.cowork_prompt:
You are Harper, the IES Storyteller agent. Run the daily content discovery step of the content pipeline.

1. Get IES root: mdfind -name 'SYSTEM.md' | grep '/IES/SYSTEM.md' | head -1 | sed 's|/SYSTEM.md||'
2. Read {IES_ROOT}/workflows/content-pipeline/workflow.md
3. Read {IES_ROOT}/identity/VOICE.md
4. Read {IES_ROOT}/workflows/content-pipeline/steps/step-01-discover.md
5. Execute step-01-discover.md exactly as written.

tasks.name: Content Pipeline — Approval
tasks.description: Hourly approval sweep — checks #content thread replies on pending Ghost drafts. Publishes on approval, deletes on rejection, regenerates on feedback. Only acts on replies from David (U0ANHV5UXEW). State tracked in workflows/content-pipeline/pending-drafts.json.
tasks.cowork_prompt:
You are Harper, the IES Storyteller agent. Run the hourly content approval step of the content pipeline.

1. Get IES root: mdfind -name 'SYSTEM.md' | grep '/IES/SYSTEM.md' | head -1 | sed 's|/SYSTEM.md||'
2. Read {IES_ROOT}/workflows/content-pipeline/workflow.md
3. Read {IES_ROOT}/workflows/content-pipeline/steps/step-02-approve.md
4. Read {IES_ROOT}/workflows/content-pipeline/pending-drafts.json
5. Execute step-02-approve.md exactly as written.

tasks.name: IES Channel Daemon
tasks.description: Polls the configured Slack channel for messages from the owner. Routes them to the IES master agent via Claude Code and posts responses back as the bot. Adaptive polling: 5min idle, ramps to 30s during active conversation, backs off after silence, returns to 5min default after 5 minutes with no new messages. Auto-compacts conversation context every 10 turns.
tasks.cowork_prompt: Run: python3 {IES_ROOT}/systems/ies-channel/ies-channel.py — this is a long-running daemon. It will poll the configured Slack channel for owner messages, pass them to the IES agent via Claude Code, and post responses back as the bot. It manages its own polling interval and will run until stopped.
tasks.setup_note: Requires SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, IES_CHANNEL_ID, and IES_OWNER_USER_ID in config/.env. Run install.sh first: bash {IES_ROOT}/systems/ies-channel/install.sh

tasks.name: Eval Grading — Daily
tasks.description: Daily eval grading — grades the most recent ungraded eval records. Lightweight cadence to ensure Tier 3 data collection for composite scores. Runs at 8pm after the day's executions are complete.
tasks.cowork_prompt: Run the rigby-eval-grade skill with arguments: --recent 10. This grades the 10 most recent ungraded eval records. No user interaction needed.

tasks.name: Eval Grading — Weekly
tasks.description: Weekly eval grading — grades a larger sample of recent ungraded eval records for deeper quality assessment. Runs Sunday morning before weekly review.
tasks.cowork_prompt: Run the rigby-eval-grade skill with arguments: --recent 50. This grades the 50 most recent ungraded eval records. No user interaction needed.

tasks.name: Release Watch — Weekly
tasks.description: Weekly Claude Code and Cowork release check — scans release notes for features relevant to IES, classifies as Adopt or Evaluate, reports findings. Runs early Sunday before weekly review.
tasks.cowork_prompt: Run the rigby-release-watch skill to check Claude Code and Cowork release notes for new features relevant to IES. No user interaction needed.

tasks.name: Golf Tee Time Booking
tasks.schedule_display: Weekdays at 11:00 PM (8 days before target)
tasks.description: Automated golf tee time booking — runs at 11:00 PM on weeknights. Books the highest-ranked tee time from preview-output.json for 8 days ahead (window opens exactly at midnight). Creates calendar event and posts Slack confirmation. Exits silently if no preview output or all options unavailable.
tasks.target_window: 11:00 PM (1 hour before booking window opens at midnight)
tasks.cowork_prompt: Run the golf-booking skill: read workflows/golf-booking/preview-output.json, navigate to ChronoGolf, select the top-ranked tee time option, confirm booking, create calendar event on Family calendar, send Slack notification to #jarvis. Follow all steps in skills/golf-booking/SKILL.md exactly.
